Class ParquetFilter

Namespace
ParquetNeo
Assembly
ParquetNeo.dll

A condition on the values of columns, which a reader checks against the statistics of each row group (the smallest and largest value, and how many are null) to skip the row groups that cannot hold a row that satisfies it. Build one with Column(params string[]) and combine with And(ParquetFilter), Or(ParquetFilter) and Not().

Remarks

A filter only prunes: a row group is skipped when its statistics prove that no row satisfies the filter, and kept when they say that one may or cannot tell (no statistics, a column of the file the filter names but the file does not have, a column in a collection). The rows of a kept row group are not filtered, so apply the condition to them as well when it must hold exactly.

A comparison with a null is false, and Not() negates, so Not(Equal(5)) is true for a null, as x != 5 is in C#. Values are compared as the column type defines: numbers, dates, times and decimals by value, text and binary by their bytes (UTF-8 for text). Enums (stored by name) and Guids can only be compared for equality; a comparison for order with them keeps every row group.
